en: Sepia-toned vintage postcard showing a street corner with a two‑storey historic building and adjacent lower houses. People in early 20th‑century clothing stand and gather along the sidewalk. Large trees frame the top of the image. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Bjelovar: Mažuranićeva ulica". Above one doorway the word "Gostiona" (inn/tavern) is visible, and on a shop to the right there is a sign reading something like "LIVORNA BAZAR".
